budget_semantics.internal_total_meaning: Finite test registration, not user authorization. 140 is a parent prospective declaration for the same finite test list; it is not a driver default or an automatic increase.

budget_semantics.remaining_controls: Whole selected plan reservation before first launch; actual success/failed exit costs plus all remaining reserves before next. Unknown missing exit cost blocks next, safe stop only at next-job boundary, no automatic retry or budget revision.

budget_semantics.acceptance: No numerical gate or strict negative result changed; internal budget admission is not scientific acceptance.
